summary: Independent reachability rebuild finds a coupled Go control plane and C++ dataplane with real apply/revision/snapshot/rollout, framed prepare/activate, epoll proxy, health/eligibility/drain, recovery, retention, and readiness paths. Validator substantive_loc=3924; honest reachable runtime/config after discounting 23 near-clone node JSON files remains ~3683, above the large_system_strict 3000 floor. TOY_LOGIC_RISK LOW; PADDING_RISK LOW.

evidence.observation: Q6 requires independent entrypoint reachability tracing, module diversity/coupling judgment, removal-test reasoning, and for large_system_strict >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC with no HIGH toy/padding risk.
Production authenticity counts only implementation that materially participates; rejects duplicated/dead/unreachable scale and micro-module inflation as substitutes for coupled operational behavior.
Advanced systems task with artifacts=/app/sovereign-lb, separate verifier mode, 7200s agent timeout, and Go/C++/bash/python languages consistent with a dual-plane load-balancer work package.
Operator build entrypoint compiles lb-control-plane and lbctl via go build and lb-dataplane via CMake/Ninja into build/bin.
Control-plane entrypoint opens api.Service, serves framed control TCP and management HTTP with graceful shutdown.
Operator CLI reaches apply/status/nodes/audit/ready/fleet/scenarios/health/retention/recovery plus local validate-fleet and list-scenarios against catalog/fleet packages.
Dataplane entrypoint wires checkpoint load, eligibility/health/drain/prober/proxy/status/control threads from node config.

All fifteen C++ translation units (main/json/protocol/snapshot/eligibility/selector/connection/proxy/health/prober/drain/checkpoint/sha256/status/control) are linked into lb-dataplane; no orphaned dataplane sources.

Apply path validates desired state, begins revision authority, compiles/stores snapshot, acquires retention leases, begins rollout, dispatches prepare; status/fleet/health/ready handlers couple ops, readiness, retention, recovery, and health aggregation.
Framed node sessions register into nodes.Registry, observe health, and drive rollout Record transitions from prepared to activating/active with SetCurrent promotion.

Dense but substantive epoll TCP proxy: listener reconcile, eligibility-aware target selection, PROXY v2 header injection, bidirectional transfer, idle/connect timeouts, and drain-compatible close paths.
Control client verifies snapshot digest via sha256, checkpoints, prepare/activate/status envelopes, publishes proxy listeners, and transitions drains across generations.
Documents real operator workflow: build, lb-control-plane, lb-dataplane with node config, lbctl management, and lab loopback backends.
Lab entrypoint execs tools/lab/backends.py, keeping Python lab helpers on the operator surface rather than dead tooling.

findings.why_it_matters: Twenty-four node JSON files differ mainly by node_id/session/status port and contribute ~253 excess LOC to the validator count. They are realistic fleet inventory inputs consumed by fleet.LoadAllProfiles/ops.ReconcileFleet, not dead clone modules, so they do not create HIGH padding risk.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: generate per-node configs from fleet.json at lab start to shrink static clone volume without changing behavior.
findings.regression_risk: Low if inventory loading and zone coverage semantics stay identical.

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Validator substantive_loc=3924 across environment/. Honest reachable runtime/config after excluding 23 near-clone node JSON files (~253 LOC) is ~3683 (Go ~2261 non-blank/non-comment; C++/hpp ~963 with dense dataplane packing; Python lab ~287; bins/scripts ~28; unique config/scenario/fleet/desired/one node ~144). Cleared large_system_strict >=3000 floor with margin after discounting inventory clone inflation. Dense C++ one-liners understate physical LOC relative to behavior density rather than padding it.
role_output.MAJOR_MODULES: cmd/lb-control-plane + internal/api — management HTTP and control session orchestration. revision/store + snapshot/compiler/repository + persistence — durable authority and generation storage. rollout/coordinator + nodes/registry — prepare/activate quorum and session fencing. recovery/bootstrap + retention/manager + readiness/evaluator + ops/reconcile + health/aggregate — restart alignment, leases, membership, readiness. fleet/loader/inventory + catalog/scenarios + lbctl — operator inventory/scenario surface. dataplane main/control/proxy/connection/selector/eligibility/health/prober/drain/checkpoint/snapshot/status/protocol/json/sha256 — live L4 forwarding, digest-checked config push, health/drain. tools/lab/backends.py + fleet_simulator.py via bin/lab — loopback lab backends.
role_output.PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing HTTP apply validation without rollout Record/activate quorum leaves generations stored but not promoted. Repairing dataplane proxy selection without eligibility/health/drain still misroutes or fails fail-open/zone policy. Checkpoint load without control digest verification accepts corrupt snapshots. Retention lease changes without readiness/ops alignment can prune active generations while status still reports ready. Fleet inventory edits without node profile/state roots break membership/quorum views.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of core (api apply/control, rollout, snapshot compile/store, proxy/control dataplane, recovery/retention/readiness) collapses apply acceptance, generation promotion, forwarding, or restart semantics. Removing only the 23 excess node JSON clones would leave single-zone lab operable but shrink multi-zone inventory realism; that deletion does not remove coupled logic. No large unreachable Go package or unlinked C++ TU was found whose deletion would leave operator behavior intact.
role_output.REQUIRED_CHANGES: None for Q6 PASS. Optional later hygiene: derive node configs from fleet.json to trim static clone LOC.
